description.value: The Patch Brewery is a farm-to-table craft brewery and taproom situated on Laity Farms in Maple Ridge, brewing with BC-sourced hops and barley grown on the property — a true farm-to-glass operation rooted in a family farming heritage dating to 1879. Alongside a rotating tap list, the brewery serves artisan pizzas, coffee drinks, and has a picnic area that welcomes dogs. It is a notable stop for cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley, blending a working farm setting with a full kitchen and a well-stocked taproom.

address.value: 12745 Laity Street, Maple Ridge, BC V4R 2P3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is actively open ('We Are Open!'), with address (12745 Laity Street, Maple Ridge) and phone (604-462-3181) matching OSM tags exactly. The site documents vegan and gluten-free menu options and cans available to go, but contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging. The OSM name includes 'Laity Farms' which does not appear anywhere on the website, which consistently uses only 'The Patch Brewery.'
concerns: OSM name includes 'Laity Farms' (full name: 'The Patch Brewery Laity Farms') but the website consistently uses only 'The Patch Brewery' — the 'Laity Farms' suffix does not appear anywhere in the website content and may be an OSM-specific addition or outdated branding.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating craft brewery and taproom with food service, confirmed open by the website. A strong destination stop for touring cyclists in the Maple Ridge area.

Takeout.detail: Website states beers are available in four-packs to go, sold exclusively at the brewery. Does not sell or fill growlers

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states all salads and pizzas can be made vegan with vegan cheese and meat substitutes; gluten-free beer and cider available; gluten-friendly pizza crust option available (not recommended for celiac due to shared oven)
